notes.title: Bug Fixes for Boss Rush Mode (03/29)
notes.notes:
Today, we have released an update to fix the following issues.
Please note that this update does not change the version number.

◼️ Issues Fixed
After watching Movie Mode, selecting and then canceling "Shining Treffy," "Ulfur Thor," or "Phantom Thief Black Cherry" in Boss Rush would incorrectly register as a story selection.

Typographical error in the Japanese encyclopedia description for "Ulfur Thor Cryo-rex."

◼️ Fix Details
The special progress data for Movie Mode in the story is now reset when starting Boss Rush.

Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Bug Fixes for Boss Rush Mode (03/28)
notes.notes:
Today, we have released an update to fix the following issues.
Please note that this update does not change the version number.

◼️ Issues Fixed

Returning from Boss Rush would incorrectly transition to the story screen.

When attempting to retire during Boss Rush, a story skip confirmation would appear, and the boss battle would be marked as a victory.

◼️ Cause of the Issues

Boss Rush was starting while retaining the current story progress.

◼️ Fix Details

The current story progress is now reset when starting Boss Rush.

Additionally, the following behavior is intended and is part of the game’s specifications:

When clearing Boss Rush with Ulfur Thor, trophies will also be awarded for Ulfur Thor’s other transformations.
This is intended to prevent unnecessary repetition since the play style is the same.

Trophies are shared across all Boss Rush modes.

Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Notice of Release Date Change
notes.notes:
The Steam version of “Kokoro Clover SUN” Super Ancient Invaders! The scheduled distribution date has been changed as follows.

Before the change
December 2024

After the change
Around February 2025

We believe that we have not had enough time to confirm and review the specifications of the game, so we have decided to combine the delivery date with that of the Switch version, which was scheduled to be delivered in February 2025.

We apologize to those who were looking forward to the game before the end of the year.

We look forward to your continued support of the “Kokoro Clover” series.
